ch000.alt: A brick archway spanning a Shanghai lane, three roundels on it reading Ping'an Li, opening on a narrow stone-paved alley lined with old shikumen houses.
ch000.caption: Old shikumen lane-houses of Shanghai. (The 2019 reprint's caption; a photograph added by its editor, not a figure of the 1933 book.)

ch001.alt: A man on a doorstep pressing a diamond-set fortune character and red paper couplets onto a weathered wooden door.
ch001.caption: Pasting up spring couplets. (The 2019 reprint's caption; a photograph added by its editor, not a figure of the 1933 book.)

ch001.before: The lazy streak in the Chinese
ch001.alt: An ink line-drawing of a woman in an apron reaching up with a long feather-duster to sweep the eaves of a shopfront while a child looks on; a cartouche reads Sweeping the Eaves-Dust.
ch001.caption: The year-end cleaning. (The 2019 reprint's caption, given to a period line-drawing titled "Sweeping the Eaves-Dust" that its editor added; not a figure of the 1933 book.)

ch001.before: Through the first days of the New Year, men and women
ch001.alt: A laughing little girl in a red brocade jacket holding a candied-hawthorn stick and red envelopes beside a door bearing the character for spring.
ch001.caption: In new clothes. (The 2019 reprint's caption; a photograph added by its editor, not a figure of the 1933 book.)

ch001.before: Close the shop and you let off
ch001.alt: Fireworks and firecrackers throwing up sprays of sparks in a dark courtyard, with two figures silhouetted against the glare.
ch001.caption: Setting off firecrackers. (The 2019 reprint's caption; a photograph added by its editor, not a figure of the 1933 book.)

ch002.alt: A studio portrait of a clean-shaven young man in a high-collared Western coat and tie, hair swept back.
ch002.caption: Song Jiaoren. (Reprint caption: 'Song Jiaoren'. A photograph added by the 2019 editor, not a figure of the 1933 book.)

ch002.before: everyone knows them for Zhao Bingjun
ch002.alt: A studio portrait of a mustached man in an embroidered silk mandarin gown with a round dragon roundel.
ch002.caption: Ying Guixin, the go-between in the plot. (Reprint caption: 'Ying Guixin'. A photograph added by the 2019 editor, not a figure of the 1933 book.)

ch002.before: Earlier, after Mr. Song had declined
ch002.alt: A drawn portrait of a balding man in wire-rimmed spectacles, wing collar and cravat.
ch002.caption: Hong Shuzu, who relayed the orders. (Reprint caption: 'Hong Shuzu'. An image added by the 2019 editor, not a figure of the 1933 book.)

ch002.alt: A studio portrait of a heavyset man with a small mustache in a dark Chinese gown, a landscape backdrop behind.
ch002.caption: Zhao Bingjun, Yuan's premier and the case's named principal. (Reprint caption: 'Zhao Bingjun'. A photograph added by the 2019 editor, not a figure of the 1933 book.)

ch003.alt: A studio portrait of a man with a small mustache in a pale high-collared Chinese jacket.

ch005.before: Cai Yuanpei, Wu Zhihui, Zhang Taiyan
ch005.alt: A portrait of a broad-faced man with short hair and a level gaze, in a dark collared jacket.
ch005.caption: Zhang Taiyan. (Reprint caption: 'Zhang Taiyan'. A photograph added by the 2019 editor, not a figure of the 1933 book.)

ch006.before: In the Wuxu coup at the close
ch006.alt: A full-length studio portrait of a bearded elderly man in a silk gown, standing before a flowered backdrop.
ch006.caption: Kang Youwei. (Reprint caption: 'Kang Youwei'. A photograph added by the 2019 editor, not a figure of the 1933 book.)

ch010.alt: A magazine cover, a line drawing of a bobbed-haired young woman resting her chin on her hand over a closed book, lettered 'The Saturday, No. 122'.
ch010.caption: A cover of the fiction weekly Libai Liu (The Saturday). (Reprint illustration added by the 2019 editor, not a figure of the 1933 book.)

ch010.before: Speaking of all these many magazines
ch010.alt: The front page of a tabloid-format weekly with the masthead character-title 'Shenghuo' set in a decorative border.
ch010.caption: Zou Taofen's Shenghuo (Life) Weekly. (Reprint illustration added by the 2019 editor, not a figure of the 1933 book.)

ch010.before: As for how often they come out
ch010.alt: A magazine cover with a bold title 'Shiritan' above a crowded allegorical drawing, lettered 'Decameron No. 35'.
ch010.caption: Shao Xunmei's Shiritan (Decameron). (Reprint illustration added by the 2019 editor, not a figure of the 1933 book.)

ch012.before: The middle stretch of Fuzhou Road
ch012.alt: A street photograph of a busy multi-story corner building with shop signboards and pedestrians, in old Shanghai.
ch012.caption: Bookshops on Fuzhou Road, old Shanghai. (Reprint caption: 'Old Shanghai, Fuzhou Road bookshops'. A photograph added by the 2019 editor, not a figure of the 1933 book.)

ch013.caption: A cartoon of the Chunliu Society's benefit performance in Japan (the playbill names Camille). (Reprint caption: 'A cartoon concerning the Chunliu Society's charity performance in Japan'. Added by the 2019 editor, not a figure of the 1933 book.)
